page_title: MCI 1-1 CHE | Manchester City v Chelsea 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+5' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Manchester City as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

90+5' Play continues despite the shouts by some Manchester City players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Andy Madley interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+4' Surely that's handball by one of the Chelsea players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+4' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is about to take a corner kick.
90+3' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) is first to the rebound and attempts to beat the keeper from long range. It's a decent effort, but flies just over the bar.

90+1' A big opportunity is wasted by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Ederson pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the right post, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort.
90' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

90' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
88' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
86' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
85' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) for his blatant foul.
84' One of the players from Chelsea times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
83' 1 - 1 Goal! Rodri (Manchester City) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Djordje Petrovic. He makes it 1:1.
82' Here comes a substitution. Nicolas Jackson is given a rest as he is replaced by Cesare Casadei (Chelsea).
80' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.
80' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared.
78' Kevin De Bruyne plays a lofted pass into the six-yard box. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gets his head on the ball but balloons it high over the bar.
77' A cross by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
76' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) comes to nothing.
76' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
74' Total attempts – 23:8. 3:5 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
72' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) replaces Cole Palmer.
69' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
66' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
65' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
65' Manchester City take a short corner kick.

65' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
64' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) replaces Julian Alvarez.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Raheem Sterling will be replaced by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea).
62' Djordje Petrovic (Chelsea) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Djordje Petrovic (Chelsea) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
62' This would have been a magnificent goal from Rodri (Manchester City), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the left post.

61' Phil Foden (Manchester City) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Andy Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' Manchester City players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.

56' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the bottom right corner, but Ederson was alert and made an amazing save! Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Ederson shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
54' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

54' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
53' A precise short pass from Nicolas Jackson releases Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
51' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
51' An attempted cross from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is cleared.
50' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) commits a foul and Andy Madley immediately signals a free kick.

49' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Phil Foden, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
48' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
47' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Manchester City win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' He should have done better. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is afforded space to connect with a Nathan Ake cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the right post.
45+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.

45+2' A pass lands at the feet of Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
45' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

45' Phil Foden (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.
43' Phil Foden (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

42' 0 - 1 GOAL! Nicolas Jackson finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Raheem Sterling (Chelsea), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 0:1.
41' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
35' Phil Foden (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
35' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
33' The shot by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Djordje Petrovic.
33' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) dribbles into the box, but Ederson is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
30' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Manchester City win a free kick.
30' 7:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 1:2.
27' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) launches a cross from the corner, but Djordje Petrovic is alert to thwart the effort.
25' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
25' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
24' Manchester City take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
23' Great save! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Ederson.
22' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) offside.
19' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

18' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Cole Palmer, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. Corner kick. Chelsea will have an opportunity.
16' Rodri (Manchester City) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.

13' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ederson pulls off an easy save.
12' Julian Alvarez swings the cross over. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the right post.

10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Phil Foden (Manchester City), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.
8' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
6' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea).
3' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
2' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) receives a pass from Erling Haaland and goes for glory with an effort from distance, but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
Andy Madley is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
